parameters.content:
## START HERE: Unassigned-Job Aging Watch (DRAFT v0.2.0)
A read-only 15-minute poll for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical shops. It flags jobs sitting in Unassigned past a configurable threshold (default 20 minutes), blank skill tags, missing zone assignments, and multi-tech / multi-day jobs that Dispatch Pro Auto Mode can silently drop or ping-pong. The alert goes to the OWNER only (email and/or Slack). An SMS-length summary is included in the payload for the same owner channels. Nothing is written back to the board.

**Do these in order:**
1. Import this file (done). It is inactive, and the 15-minute Schedule node is switched off.
2. Leave **source** = test and click **Execute workflow** on Manual Test Run. The result is a [TEST] alert built from fictional sample data.
3. Compare it with sample_aging_alert.md.
4. Switch to **csv** (your own ServiceTitan job export) and re-run. Still [TEST].
5. Only then think about go-live. See the Go live note.

Status: DRAFT. Designed from public ServiceTitan docs and checked as importable JSON. NOT tested against a live ServiceTitan, Gmail, or Slack account.

## Config fields
- **source**: test (built-in fictional data, default) | csv (read exports from csvFolder) | servicetitan (live read-only GETs). Anything else falls back to test.
- **testMode**: ON by default. Messages are labeled [TEST]. source = test always forces it on.
- **delivery**: email | slack | both | none. Owner only. The alert text is also short enough to paste into an owner SMS, but this draft does not include a Twilio or customer-SMS node.
- **ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel**: YOUR address and a private channel. Never a customer.
- **stApiBase / stTenantId / stAppKey**: paste-here placeholders for the live path. Unused unless source = servicetitan.
- **csvFolder**: folder with aging_jobs.csv (or jobs.csv with the same columns) and optional technicians.csv. n8n only reads files inside its allowed folder.
- **asOfOverride**: optional ISO time to pretend it is a different moment. Blank = now.
- **agingThresholdMinutes**: how long a job may sit in Unassigned before it is flagged. Default 20 (use 15–20 to match how your shop works).

## Safety defaults
- Imported **inactive**; 15-minute Schedule **disabled**.
- **testMode** ON; source = **test**.
- **Read-only / zero board write-back**: ServiceTitan nodes are GET only. No POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE. The dispatcher stays 100% in control.
- **No customer messages**: there is no SMS, no Twilio, and no customer email node anywhere in this file.
- It never assigns, reassigns, or moves a job. It only flags.
- Never invents numbers. A metric that cannot be computed becomes a "Heads-up" line.

## Live path: ServiceTitan v2 REST reads (all GET). UNVERIFIED against a real tenant.
Base: {stApiBase}/{module}/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/... plus header ST-App-Key. Auth is an n8n OAuth2 credential (client credentials) named PLACEHOLDER_SERVICETITAN; n8n fetches the token, so this workflow never POSTs to ServiceTitan.
Jobs: jpm/v2/.../jobs | Appointments: jpm/v2/.../appointments | Appointment assignments: dispatch/v2/.../appointment-assignments | Technicians: settings/v2/.../technicians
Exact paths, query names, response fields, and skill/zone field names are from public docs and memory and must be confirmed before use. First page only (pageSize 200). If a skill or zone field is not present on the job record, it is flagged as missing rather than guessed.

## CSV export fallback (recommended first step, and the path for Starter / Essentials)
Export your own job report to aging_jobs.csv or jobs.csv (see fixtures/aging_jobs.csv for columns, including skill, zone, tech_ids, unassigned_since, and multi_day), drop it in csvFolder, set source = csv, and set asOfOverride if the export is not from this moment. This path only READS files. Source = test uses the same fictional file, built in.

## Credentials (placeholders only)
PLACEHOLDER_SERVICETITAN (OAuth2, live path only), PLACEHOLDER_GMAIL, PLACEHOLDER_SLACK. Attach your own. No secrets, client IDs, or tenant IDs are stored in this file. Do not paste real ones into Config and then share the workflow.

## Hard stop before go-live
Do not turn testMode off or switch the 15-minute Schedule on until: (1) a clean [TEST] run from sample data, (2) a clean [TEST] run from YOUR csv export, spot-checked by hand against ServiceTitan, (3) ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel confirmed as owner-only, (4) an owner has signed off in writing. Even live, this workflow only reports to the owner. It will not contact customers or change ServiceTitan.
